title: Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funeral
html:
Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funeral

At least 24 people have been killed after a boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized in Nigeria. Another 24 were rescued. Early reports suggest a mechanical fault, while the operator reportedly ignored calls to steer towards shore before fleeing.
summary: At least 24 people have been killed after a boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized in Nigeria.
